:::{#thm-ci-log-OR}

#### Confidence interval for a log odds ratio

In a [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression),
let $\vx$ and $\vxs$ be two covariate patterns,
let $\eb$ be the [maximum likelihood estimate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) of $\vb$,
and let $\edifflogodds$ be the estimated difference in log-odds.
For large samples,
an approximate 95% [confidence interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/inference.html#def-confidence-interval) for the logarithm of the odds ratio,
$\logf{\ror(\vx,\vxs)} = \difflogodds$,
is:

$$\difflogodds \in \paren{\edifflogodds \pm 1.96 \cdot \HSE{\edifflogodds}}$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-or-diff-logodds.

:::
